CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.is_izytel_finance_admin()
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  select public.is_izytel_firebase_jwt()
    and exists (
      select 1
      from public.izytel_staff_access staff
      where staff.firebase_uid = (select auth.jwt()->>'sub')
        and staff.is_active = true
        and staff.role = 'admin'
    );
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.izytel_wc5_manager_owns_zone(p_zone_id text, p_manager_uid text)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  select exists (
    select 1
    from public.territory_zones z
    join public.izytel_staff_access s on s.firebase_uid = z.manager_id
    where z.id = btrim(coalesce(p_zone_id, ''))
      and z.is_active = true
      and z.manager_id = btrim(coalesce(p_manager_uid, ''))
      and s.is_active = true
      and s.role in ('manager','supervisor')
  );
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.phase4_reset_for_manual_assignment(p_order_id text)
 RETURNS phase4_assignment_orders
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare
  v_row public.phase4_assignment_orders;
  v_previous_agent text;
begin
  if not private.is_izytel_phase4_staff() then
    raise exception 'STAFF_REQUIRED';
  end if;

  select assigned_agent_id into v_previous_agent
  from public.phase4_assignment_orders
  where order_id = p_order_id
  for update;
  if not found then raise exception 'ORDER_NOT_SYNCED'; end if;

  if v_previous_agent is not null then
    update public.phase4_assignment_history h
    set status = 'reassigned', updated_at = now()
    where h.id = (
      select h2.id
      from public.phase4_assignment_history h2
      where h2.order_id = p_order_id
        and h2.agent_id = v_previous_agent
        and h2.status in ('assigned','accepted')
      order by h2.assigned_at desc
      limit 1
    );
  end if;

  update public.phase4_assignment_plans
  set candidate_agent_ids = '{}'::text[],
      candidate_names = '{}'::jsonb,
      refused_agent_ids = '{}'::text[],
      plan_mode = 'manual',
      updated_at = now()
  where order_id = p_order_id;

  update public.phase4_assignment_orders
  set assignment_state = 'manual_required',
      assigned_agent_id = null,
      assigned_agent_name = null,
      assigned_by_uid = (select auth.jwt()->>'sub'),
      assignment_mode = null,
      assigned_at = null,
      last_refusal_reason = null,
      last_refused_at = null,
      last_refused_agent_id = null,
      firebase_assignment_synced_at = null,
      firebase_handoff_at = null,
      updated_at = now()
  where order_id = p_order_id
  returning * into v_row;

  return v_row;
end;
$function$

functions.name: enqueue_izytel_notification
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.enqueue_izytel_notification(p_recipient_uid text, p_event_type text, p_title text, p_body text, p_data jsonb DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb, p_dedupe_key text DEFAULT NULL::text)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
begin
  if nullif(btrim(coalesce(p_recipient_uid, '')), '') is null then return; end if;
  insert into public.izytel_notification_outbox (
    recipient_uid, event_type, title, body, data, dedupe_key
  ) values (
    btrim(p_recipient_uid),
    btrim(coalesce(p_event_type, 'generic')),
    left(coalesce(nullif(btrim(p_title), ''), 'IzyTel'), 160),
    left(coalesce(nullif(btrim(p_body), ''), 'Nouvelle notification IzyTel.'), 500),
    coalesce(p_data, '{}'::jsonb),
    nullif(btrim(coalesce(p_dedupe_key, '')), '')
  )
  on conflict (dedupe_key) do nothing;
end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.is_phase5_proof_owner(p_order_id text)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  select public.is_izytel_firebase_jwt()
    and exists (
      select 1 from public.phase4_assignment_orders o
      where o.order_id=btrim(coalesce(p_order_id,''))
        and o.assigned_agent_id=(select auth.jwt()->>'sub')
        and o.assignment_state in ('accepted','handed_off')
        and o.order_status in ('inProgress','onHold')
        and o.legacy_state_unresolved=false
    );
$function$

functions.name: izytel_finance_phase5_touch
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.izytel_finance_phase5_touch()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
begin
  update public.finance_change_feed
     set revision = revision + 1,
         changed_at = now()
   where id = 1;
  if not found then
    insert into public.finance_change_feed(id, revision, changed_at)
    values (1, 1, now())
    on conflict (id) do update
      set revision = public.finance_change_feed.revision + 1,
          changed_at = now();
  end if;
  return null;
end;
$function$

 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  select coalesce(
    private.izytel_current_staff_role() in ('manager','supervisor')
    and exists(
      select 1
      from public.partner_accounts p
      where p.id=p_partner_id
        and p.zone_ids && private.izytel_current_manager_zone_ids()
    ),
    false
  );
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.izytel_resolve_manager_for_zone_ids(p_zone_ids text[])
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  select case when count(distinct z.manager_id)=1 then min(z.manager_id) else null end
  from public.territory_zones z
  where z.is_active=true
    and z.id=any(coalesce(p_zone_ids,'{}'::text[]))
    and nullif(btrim(coalesce(z.manager_id,'')),'') is not null;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.izytel_wc5_completed_order_message()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
begin
  if new.order_status='completed'
     and old.order_status is distinct from new.order_status then
    perform private.izytel_wc5_emit_customer_system_message(
      new.order_id,
      new.order_reference,
      'Votre commande ' || new.order_reference ||
      ' a été traitée avec succès.'
    );
  end if;
  return new;
end;
$function$

functions.name: izytel_wc5_fallback_zone_id
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.izytel_wc5_fallback_zone_id()
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare v_zone_id text;
begin
  select z.id into v_zone_id
  from public.territory_zones z
  where z.is_active = true and z.is_central_fallback = true
  order by z.updated_at desc, z.id
  limit 1;

  if v_zone_id is null then
    select z.id into v_zone_id
    from public.territory_zones z
    where z.is_active = true and lower(btrim(z.city)) = 'abidjan'
    order by
      case when z.latitude is null or z.longitude is null then 1 else 0 end,
      case when z.latitude is null or z.longitude is null then null else
        6371.0 * 2.0 * asin(sqrt(
          power(sin(radians(z.latitude - 5.35995) / 2.0), 2)
          + cos(radians(5.35995)) * cos(radians(z.latitude))
          * power(sin(radians(z.longitude - (-4.00826)) / 2.0), 2)
        ))
      end nulls last,
      z.id
    limit 1;
  end if;

  if v_zone_id is null then
    raise exception 'CENTRAL_ZONE_NOT_CONFIGURED' using errcode = 'P0001';
  end if;
  return v_zone_id;
end;
$function$
